maddeler.e:
احتكمت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَمْتُ (iḥtakamtu) /iħ.ta.kam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# اِحْتَكَمْتَ (iḥtakamta) /iħ.ta.kam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# اِحْتَكَمْتِ (iḥtakamti) /iħ.ta.kam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# اِحْتَكَمَتْ (iḥtakamat) /iħ.ta.ka.mat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
